correctness.rationale: From actual RESULT.md: increasing-tree root decomposition with F(x;u,z)=sum x^n E[u^R z^K]/n gives F_x=u(1-x)^(-z(1-p))(1-u+u(1-x)^p)^(-z). Direct parent/edge conditional expectations yield C_{n+1}=(1+p/n)C_n+p/n-p a_n/n^2; telescoping after dividing by a_n gives exact covariance and positivity for n>=3. L2-bounded R_n/a_n martingale and independent late root-attachment indicators after m_n=floor(exp(sqrt(log n))) establish joint Gaussian/Mittag-Leffler independence, not finite-n independence. Independently checked exact recurrence rationally for p=1/4,1/2,3/4 and n<=9 and checked actual verify.py code; bounded checks are corroborative only. Deterministic p=0,1 excluded from stated asymptotics.
